//: Web content module -> remake module (paths from the repo root, normalised: no '.', '..' or '//'). The exporter's redirect plugin (unreal/Tools/export-data/run.mjs) loads the GameData module wherever any module imports the web one. A target that does not exist, a web path that is never loaded during the export, a GameData module the export never loads, or a GameData module that imports a redirected web path fails the export. See README.md.
//snapshots: sha256 of each GameData module as first copied from the web module (import / export specifiers blanked; remake.ts snapshotHash). A module whose digest differs has been remade: the files built from it get remake.modules. Recorded once when the snapshot is taken (the export prints the digest for a missing entry); never updated afterwards, and never compared with the live web file.
